name: Semín
locality: Political district of Chrudim; Pardubice District; Přelouč Judicial District
text: Semín is a municipality and village in Pardubice District in the Pardubice Region of the Czech Republic. It has about 600 inhabitants.

depictions.name: Semine
depictions.text: Semine is a fortress in the Trosky region, with a small village situated around it. The local lord is Jan Semine, an impoverished nobleman who lives there with his family.
